title: [Feature Request]: resolve methods of ContentBlock classes error when empty bytes
body:
### Feature Description

`resolve` methods of `ContentBlock` classes should raise an error when they yield empty bytes, to avoid empty documents to be passed to LLMs. 

### Reason

See discussion under issue #18789

### Value of Feature

_No response_

linked_prs.title: Throw error if resolve methods yield empty bytes
linked_prs.body:
# Description

The `resolve` methods for all the classes belonging to ContentBlock is now equipped with a checking mechanism that throws an error if the operation yielded zero bytes.

Fixes #18813
